name: underwriting-starter
title: Underwriting starter
summary: Everyday underwriting work on nine lines of business in Ohio: full premiums, table lookups, schedule rating, minimums, endorsements, eligibility, state exceptions, claims-made tails, return premiums and errors in filed manuals.
description: Each task gives the AI the filed rate and rule documents it needs, from public filings for one line of business, and states its facts in the question. It asks for exact values: a premium, a factor, a rule, or the errors in the documents themselves. The lines run through commercial property, general liability, professional and medical liability, personal auto, pet, farm, contract surety and title. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Full premium
families.what: The whole rating chain, through base rate, factors, limits and deductibles, to the final premium.

families.name: Table lookup
families.what: The right cell of a rate or factor table by class, band or tier, interpolating where the filing says to.

families.name: Schedule rating
families.what: Debits and credits for a risk, held to each characteristic's limit and the state's total cap.

families.name: Minimum premium
families.what: When the premium the rules produce falls under a minimum, and what follows.

families.name: Endorsement premium
families.what: The charge for an endorsement: flat, per limit, a percentage, or subject to its own minimum.

families.name: Eligibility and rules
families.what: Whether a risk or a coverage is eligible, and which rule of the manual governs.

families.name: State exceptions
families.what: Where the state's pages replace or delete the countrywide rule, renewal and rate capping included.

families.name: Claims-made and tail
families.what: Claims-made triggers, retroactive dates, maturity years and extended reporting premiums.

families.name: Return premium
families.what: The premium returned or reduced on a cancellation, a suspension or a midterm change.

families.name: Checking the filings
families.what: The filing's own errors, told apart from passages that only look wrong.
